{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
valid_orders = sales[
    (sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) &
    (sales['status'] == 'completed') &
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal')
]

# Compute mean revenue for loyal customers with completed orders
mean_revenue = valid_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers: {mean_revenue}")"}
